answer: A replica identity stranded offshore of the honest quorum gets drained: before any vote counts, each node must escrow 80,000 POA into a timelocked bond, and a failed verification cracks the deposit open so half burns and half pays the peers who did the audit. Like a reef, the rule is only visible when the tide of sympathy drops - appeals are heard, never credited, and no marble facade of politeness buys an exception. A fraudster therefore loses 40,000 POA per pearl of a fake self, while honest nodes merely wait out the lock.
